scope: Read-only documentary presentation of the current completed campaign. No authored BMC, assessment, balance-sheet or complete cash-flow model is introduced.
lookup: FinalReportController.Refresh reads GameSessionRepository.GetById(GameSessionState.Current.sessionId), RoundResultRepository.GetBySessionId and SessionEventHistoryRepository.GetBySession on every visit/retry. Reports from another session, duplicate/invalid months and nonfinite amounts are rejected.

conclusion_fields.company: GameSessionEntity.companyName; explicit missing label if blank
conclusion_fields.participant_and_ra: GameSessionEntity.studentName and studentRA; no preview or fallback identity
conclusion_fields.completed_state: GameSessionEntity.status == COMPLETED; BANKRUPT never becomes a successful final report
conclusion_fields.period: QuarterlyResultPresentation.Count of saved rounds 1..3; denominator 3 is the unchanged campaign length
conclusion_fields.conclusion: Presentation sentence conditional on completed status and saved-month count; no performance grade is invented
conclusion_fields.revenue: Sum of RoundResultEntity.grossRevenue for saved months, through UI-14 displayed-cent aggregation
conclusion_fields.net_cash_result: Sum of RoundResultEntity.netResult for saved months through UI-14 aggregation
conclusion_fields.last_cash: RoundResultEntity.closingCash of the last saved month, not a sum of balances
conclusion_fields.final_reputation: Last saved RoundResultEntity.reputationAtEnd; /100 matches the existing reputation bound
conclusion_fields.final_alignment: Last saved RoundResultEntity.alignmentScore and alignmentClassification; translated only for presentation
conclusion_fields.monthly_links: One enabled button per persisted round 1..3; MonthlyResultController.OpenFromFinal queries that exact round and session
conclusion_fields.quarterly_link: Existing UI-14 QuarterlyResultPresentation; all 25 metrics and their rules are retained

bmc_blocks.absence: No partner model or saved partner response; explicit unrecorded information
Restaurant selection is evidence only; no detailed activities or authored BMC response
Missing arrays differ from a saved empty selection; unknown catalog IDs remain unavailable; malformed JSON produces an error

bmc_blocks.source: restaurantType, locationZone, menuPricingJson.items (productId, selectedPrice), Restaurants/Locations/ProductData labels
bmc_blocks.absence: Displays confirmed restaurant/location/menu/prices, never claims to be an authored value proposition
Reputation does not imply a relationship strategy; the strategy is explicitly unrecorded
No channel model or saved channel response
Only the saved target and location are presented; no invented segmentation research

bmc_blocks.source: Sum of saved RoundResultEntity.TotalCosts through QuarterlyResultPresentation.Rows[7]
bmc_blocks.absence: Loan payment already includes principal and interest; does not include unsaved months or imply full accounting cost allocation

bmc_blocks.source: Sum of saved grossRevenue and netResult
bmc_blocks.absence: No revenue split by product/channel exists

reflection_fields.choices: EstablishmentSummaryService.Build(session.Copy()).Decisions: saved location, restaurant/target, menu/prices, creditLineId/loanBalance, equipmentJson and teamJson resolved through existing catalogs. Detached completed copy prevents a forecast or database query in this projection.
reflection_fields.event_choices: SessionEventHistoryEntity.round, eventName, selectedChoiceTitle, selectedChoiceText; immutable historical snapshots. Ordered by round/day. These are option choices, not reflection answers.
reflection_fields.reflection_questions_and_answers: Unavailable: no questionnaire model, player-response storage, justification history or teacher-feedback service exists. No inputs or fake submission/offline status are exposed.
reflection_fields.guiding_character: CH01_GUIDING as an independent whole sprite with white tint, preserveAspect and no raycast; reserved column beside a separate masked ScrollRect

documentary_gaps.gap: No complete cash-flow or balance-sheet model; existing monthly cash statements remain accurately named and are the only financial report data
No persisted reflective questions, answers, justifications, diagnostic feedback or teacher review
No authored BMC model, partners, channels, detailed activities, value-proposition text or relationship strategy; saved choices provide a partial evidence canvas only
Choices are the final saved state; no time series of every earlier setup edit exists

resume_metadata.finalSummaryAcknowledged: New boolean presentation metadata, default false for old rows. Set only on explicit ContinueAfterSummary for a saved completed result; never changes economic fields. Reload before Continue returns to Round_Summary; after acknowledgement it returns to FinalReport.
resume_metadata.finalReportArchived: New boolean presentation metadata, default false. Set only after explicit confirmed New game. Preserves completed session, results, event history and event plan. The replacement is memory-only until the existing D3 INSERT.
resume_metadata.precedence: Active/incompatible saves keep priority. Only the latest finished session for the same user can be recovered; a later bankruptcy never revives an older successful campaign. Existing bankruptcy destination and presentation remain owned by UI-16.
resume_metadata.archived_report_limit: Archived completed rows remain in SQLite; a historical multi-campaign browser is not added by UI-15. The current completed campaign remains consultable until the user explicitly starts a new game.
